text:
deploybot: automated policy detected an embeddings cost regression in eu-central-1; recommended auto-revert to image v2.7.4 in 12m. :rotating_light:

mina: saw the alert. embed_cost_p90 ~2.2x baseline for the last 7m. no customer-facing errors yet.

alex: latest PR enabled micro-batch packing for embeddings path. might be inflating CPU/GPU ops for certain token counts.

ops-ravi: auto-revert scheduled in 9m. options: full revert to v2.7.3, targeted micro-batch disable on canary, or traffic-slice away affected tenants.

sre-kim: prefer quick canary toggle first. if canary shows improvement >50% cost reduction within 5m, propagate regionally. I'll watch cost and latency dashboards.

mina: can we hold the auto-revert for 15m to allow the canary probe? request hold by engineering.

deploybot: hold requested by @mina. auto-revert suppressed for 15m. reason=engineering_probe

alex: running canary toggle now on pool eu-central-canary:
```bash
rdwctl pool update eu-central-canary --env "MICRO_BATCH=false"
rdwctl rollout status eu-central-canary
```

ops-ravi: tagging @sre-kim to monitor the metrics stream. key panels: embed_cost_per_1k_tokens, embed_p90_latency, tenant_impact_count.

(4m later)

sre-kim: canary shows cost down ~66%, latency unchanged. good signal.

mina: if canary is green, prefer progressive config rollout rather than image revert. Which approach reduces customer churn?

ops-ravi: progressive config rollout is low-risk. plan: 5% increments every 90s across shards, re-evaluate at 30% and 60%. if cost improvement stalls, fallback to full image revert. set a temporary pin to v2.7.3 for 12h to avoid image churn during mitigation.

pm-lucy: PMs ask for explicit release-note entry and customer comms template in case we touch billing. legal-bot: loop me for billing language.

legal-bot: acknowledged. prepare tenant list when ready; we'll pre-approve wording.

alex: proposed commands:
```bash
rdwctl rollout config eu-central-1 --set MICRO_BATCH=false --steps 5 --interval 90s
rdwctl pin set service:embeddings eu-central-1 --version 2.7.3 --duration 12h --reason "mitigate embeddings cost regression"
```

deploybot: starting staged config rollout at 5% with suppression in place. temporary_threshold raised to 2.5x to avoid flapping.

sre-kim: metrics at 25%: region-wide cost down ~48%, no error increase. continuing.

ops-ravi: runbook note for oncall: if embed_cost_p90 > 1.6x baseline for 10m AND affected_tenants > 4 -> tag eng-releases rollback_exec and execute full revert to v2.7.3 image.

mina: fine with that. i'll update release notes: "mitigation: temporarily disabled micro-batching and pinned embeddings runtime in eu-central-1 to address transient cost increase."

pm-lucy: drafting customer note for any tenant impacted >24h. will share in #product-review.

legal-bot: standing by for tenant list to approve billing wording.

ops-ravi: rollout reached 100% propagation and pin applied. monitoring window set to 2h.

sre-kim: current telemetry stable. cost back near baseline, latency nominal. closing unless we see reoccurrence.

deploybot: auto-revert unsuppressed after pin expiry. thread closed unless new alerts appear or manual reopen requested.
